scripts.prepare: git rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1 && git config core.hooksPath .githooks || true
scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build && pnpm go:check
scripts.go:check: cd backend/daemon && gofmt -l . | (! grep .) && go vet ./... && go test ./... && go tool govulncheck ./...
